notes.title: Amazing Frog? Status Update
notes.notes: [p]As we approach the next Major update for Amazing Frog? I thought It would be a good time to share a status update of what we have been developing in Swindonshire. We have been working on some big additions.[/p][p]Often in game development some steps, that seem very small, can end up taking quite a long to implement. On the positive side when these step are done well, larger subsequent steps can begin to happen very quickly.[/p][h3]New Water?[/h3][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/57c1e2c762026a50b39a5de70cad70eaa73506bc.gif"][/img][/h3][p]We have been upgrading the Water System, making it feel more atmospheric. Which has enabled us to add many things we have been wanting to implement for some time. Things like splash effects, impact ripples and more fluid surface movement for boats and creatures.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/7fe545e494343a364d1bc13f4193dfb34fb9ec6d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The new Water has also helped up to create more synergy in the world's style throughout Swindonshire.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/e16a9602ae15832f643c042f2fab64addf265944.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Also things like shore waves (...and some new boats)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/28287454c66e08b7ad4b601b0edaf9e77a34d018.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]What is Delivery?[/h3][p]The next upcoming '[b]Job[/b]' is [i][b]Taxi Driver.[/b][/i] We needed to get this system right to empower us to create the other "delivery systems" that we have also been working on. I imagine you can guess what those other delivery systems maybe just from walking around the world. Hopefully, there will be still be some surprises in there.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/e7af5c771314d84abba6be23f45583401a32c68a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]While driving a Taxi, after you have found a citizen requesting a ride...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/6a26e7af19595e11e95c7acbf97af0cb69daf1e3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]...you will be able to earn Frog Pounds and unlock costumes depending on a speedy (and successful ) journey[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/b8f02a913444b622dae34bc0e5fa23425c7e987a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/6054cab627fa594c77ab6edc4bb366d808e14e77.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]How does it lead to Law and Order?[/h3][p]This category of task we call "Delivery" is now more dependant on more advances in NPC management and behaviours[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/875513e7a7196293e070b3df5bc8100e8ef5e877.jpg"][/img][/p][p]NPCS taking up seats and positions and even collecting or using items from the floor, but ultimately having a more determined sense of what they want do and where they need to be.[/p][p]This library that drives the behaviour is very much the basis of how we will bring 'Law and Order' to Swindon, but before we reach that goal there are still a few more steps.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Stuff to wear?[/h3][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/1041588e9b3e01cd8bae568138116545de823ef4.jpg"][/img][/h3][p]Naturally, in the next major update there will be a bunch of new outfits and accessories[/p][p][/p][p]As you know we are always building new '[b][i]Things[/i][/b]' for Amazing Frog? so expect some of that too...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/4f631e5af93ab0b5cb16708aab3bbc28c304e4a8.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Jam Patch Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/3dcb30e67d1f9a902570304b975d7e2eba3bdeeb.png[/img]
As you may know we were hit by some problems with the Jam Maker update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/f0de38177e69d822f8430a59711949503a8f433d.png[/img]
In this patch we have made sure that the process for collecting berries and turning them to jam jars was fixed! We wish we could have released it sooner. 

[h3]Buuuut, sometimes you just have to fix a bunch of stuff at once. [/h3]
(and it can take some time)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/3ecf3d57cc0fcde2c16dbee0c619b3977ede00e3.png[/img]
First, we got wrapped up in another major bug -  what happens when you eject from the jets or indeed what happens when you crash a jet... ( If you had not noticed it ... it was a bad one )

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/d29420d9277ce03145a19dad87f1f66047382d82.png[/img]
However, its not just jets that should be able to take to the skies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/5e41ced3e0767c761c1ae89bec01f77bf34acd30.jpg[/img]
[h3]Indeed, Pigs will fly![/h3]
Since one of the major parts of the Jam Maker update was the Saddle Launcher (If your Jam Maker was working) The saddle logic itself needed some care and attention.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/cc4de764b06a5e212336259be6f3b8563714c05b.png[/img]
Especially when it comes to using Jet Packs either in saddles or indeed on some bikes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/501708868a58fba28413bc231570e95bff2f77df.png[/img]
We still think we need to spend some more time on this part of the control system, but we also think we moved it a big step forward in this patch.

There were other issues that we solved and there are some that we are aware we haven't solved yet. We want to say thanks for all the feedback (and awesome artwork), we try and keep up with everything posted, it's all really very helpful and is going to lead us to leaving Early Access soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/fd5e9960ee7878070188e91b4d05ac4681f51f4c.jpg[/img]
[h3]Buuuut, The saddle logic is actually really dangerous![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/5c5ce40a1cebc2fa6394b6a3c0b039b245704ba2.jpg[/img]
I will say though, we had a lot of fun shooting each other with the Saddle Launcher. Even as i write this i am aware that there is a bug where you can continally get Saddle Launchers from the dispencer... gulp.

The saddle logic did send us a down a bit of a rabbit hole, especially when thinking about how to control a shark... we ended up following a path that had not expected to engage with so soon . Luckily it will yield a new update pretty quickly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/fa70435eedc1ef0e4dbec69f3bc656fd7895a2aa.png[/img]
This image should give you some idea of what we aaaaaaare currently wrapped up in.

notes.title: The Jam Update
notes.notes:
[h2]The Jam Maker 
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/9ce5e85a6957dbd541ab2a2b0309b3c2620d22ce.png[/img]
Yes thats right! Make Jam. A new fundemental and core system added to Swindonshire.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/14c49489171d7668a1153189ddd23aaee3781bcd.png[/img]
Here's a video with some ideas on how to farm for berries to make jam.
[previewyoutube=Mwk_pmV3HwY;full][/previewyoutube]
We are expanding our range of objects throughout the world and of course thinking about their value. This is all important mechanics that will make Law and Order have more depth... I hope its all starting to make a bit more sense now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/329e65623eb05241c03cc5e926ee5c003ccd6f3d.png[/img]
[h2]More Persistence with Collectables[/h2]
This is a feature upgrade. Have you ever been familiar with scenes like this

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/b2354d133950018246e75af34901a7bb5b9ac3a1.png[/img]
You have just been on a kill Rampage and there is just so much stuff to collect, but if you walk too far away it will all be gone?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/feea4e9a5e955547de3a94ea9d834e2a4228b673.png[/img]
Not any more...
(Heres the boring Game dev bit) 
Lots of physics objects = bad for runtime
especially when they are left just hanging around. So Gaz decided that cleaning them up after you went away would be a "normal" thing to do. but what if you need to go back to the hideout to get the vacuum or you got killed whill fighting a load of zombies? 
Since the objects are becoming increasigly valuable when we found a way to make them persist in the session. They won't stay if you refresh Swindon (ie go to moon or sewer) but the objects should stick around and wait for you to collect them.

[h2]Time To Mount UP ![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/0c77209e593793083d49431fef8faa253d2ed23d.gif[/img]

Unlock the saddle Launcher (with jam Jars) you should be able to shoot any living thing with it to add a saddle and ride it...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/c31709dbeb36d9bc49c9e37077d1a1929ecbeac2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/3733a2e70562afc23e26264e2972eae58c7c3c41.png[/img]
When you mount up, it might be easier tovisit places you could not get to before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/f7b944c258f362ee9b62f3c2039159a5d3e59a96.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/df35540bea274a71aba5249abf72883b5ad9fc83.jpg[/img]
But be careful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/1508a4dcf366a1903c815f4a9259cf90b654f91d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Team up in the Sewer.[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/2afeb620f9f41736d576d72d8a079db6139b2df3.gif[/img]

We've put some chainsaws in the sewer and a vacuum to make collecting things of the dead in teh sewer more productive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/d807618ed1bfaf09be5db2a17045d8b64cec6f44.gif[/img]
Cos Zombies carry loot too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/28c5f3b14fa67f40a3e35c34fa478b8d7e22dfe0.gif[/img]
We don't know what the fastest way to gather "stuff" is yet, what are you doing?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/167408a62f2c21f56b0f1af678ffb50023cd7b83.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/c59e5d155f76a0a8d5839f0cdea7ed61f1d84cc9.jpg[/img]

[h2]First Pathogen Dart Gun[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/c2dfc2c5bb32f142d55c0d9fc685bb2c163f6179.jpg[/img]
We won't tell you how to get it, but like the saddle launcher the gun will appear in the hideout when unlocked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/4b0d01c7972728b864628d707072bbd8378bab99.jpg[/img]
You can Infact just about anything with a pathogen dart gun

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/9dad096d45029e4908a647faa240ee7c37607d3c.jpg[/img]
And try new things

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/9addc47a7d429ae4856bb38ff1c0551fe9f90c59.png[/img]

[h2]Yeah...  there has been Fixes[/h2]
There have been fixes and there are a few new outfits and unlockables and more Magic! I won't go into detail.
One notable fix is to make the treads on the tanks more deadly and the tank shot explosions too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/95af20b50178a1a57d8fea171918ae1b020c6621.jpg[/img]
As we move towards Law and Order and "1.0" (which is very close now) we are also refining some of the core components. Jam jars, saddles and pathogen darts all work with various aspects of the evolving tech that drives frog life in Swindonshire.
[h3]Unity 6[/h3]
This was also another major step for us since we have moved the project to Unity 6 - this allows us to future proof the game and unity 6 is very much becoming a requirment for us roll out the console version when we hit 1.0 with Law and order.

Also we should be "delivering" a new update very soon.

notes.title: Chainsaw?

Now, we will start another run of updates which will add more magic, more places to spend you hard earned... um "things"... jobs, death, coffee, LAW, aliens, loads of costumes and much more and not nescessarily in that ORDER!

notes.title: A Rubbish Update for Amazing Frog?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/cf7ff2c08f0e5800ad039e48e69a4eaba3e07be3.gif[/img]
[h2]It's 'BIN DAY!'[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/2b2e02b50fbca0f2cc53e3830622ab55c5ee5370.jpg[/img]
[h3]A new Employment opportunity![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/05ee4050ebef12d752a443a26468b8adb9c7c110.jpg[/img]
[h3]Earn [b]£££[/b]'s and SCP as a BIN Frog disposing of all the rubbish on "BIN DAY".[/h3]

[previewyoutube=DFkqOkQeuLc;full][/previewyoutube]

On BIN DAY throughout Swindonshire, the residents and businesses will throw out their trash. You can earn money as well as Swindon Citizen Points (SCP) throwing the trash into the 'Waste Away' Rubbish truck.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/b6d5fe901566136555b7a87e375f96d482cb9353.jpg[/img]
Due to the back log from the holiday season its going to be "BIN DAY" for the rest of January and then every Thursday is BIN DAY in Swindonshire ! So get out there on thursdays and earn big £££'s in your brand new job!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/5400aaf91b3ed2b547ba417a6555d02b0f238bb8.jpg[/img]
We have more jobs brewing in Swindon, you can maybe guess whats some will be...

[h2]And of course there is more magic![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/a2fa75e7b01ffd719028924da7c32e38f323b4f5.gif[/img]

Just be careful what you put in the magic Toilet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/5d49b347d3b1079b356e72a8ce93ab2031583b8d.jpg[/img]
 Rubbish should be disposed of appropriatly, if not it could have disastrous effects and make me very grouchy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/10abbdd2ebed333eaa1378316612b33b2a074347.gif[/img] 

There is a few new hidden shops/costumes too... ) But Remember after January Bin Bags will only be put out on Thursdays!

[h3]NOTES from Gaz...[/h3]
As always, we have been trying to improve the core systems.  The main one we focused on this time was "throwing physical objects" (we needed it to work better in particular for bin bags), but throwing frogs also will see improvents in coming updates. There are many systems we know need some love and attention, eg falling over with grapple hook - there are work arounds, but it simply needs some of my time.
I should explain, many issues arise without us knowing. Its important to us that we always keep Amazing Frog? updated with the latest version of Unity. We don't want the system driving the game to become obselete like many did in legacy. Unfortunately with so many systems in Amazing Frog? things change beyond our control frequently and its hard to always keep track. We are so grateful when the community (on what ever platform) reaches out to let us know about issues. I do try to respond to all, but often I think my best response is to keep my head in development and fix and improve as many features as possible. 
Also, your screenshots over the holidays make us extremely happy I will have to do a post with a collection of awesome screen shots

Thanks!
( for more info or videos ? - try those "more ways to connect" buttons below )

notes.title: New features with the Magical Mystery Toilet!
notes.notes:
We've added some improvements to the world and physics as and some more fun in this update!

[h2]What's new?[/h2]
[list]

[*] Balloon Gun!
[*] Lunar Lander

[h2]A little bit of magic goes a long way[/h2]
The toilet has unlocked some of its magical powers! Any object you flush down the toilet will change size!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/2bffe4fc32f7cbf18a3166f4135901207f5e81a5.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/d919df6f7e82dd53d0e91f1c36d82284b08756ba.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/cf43216450609a53fd8306505bebb75c620699a7.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/576f650c0537bfb5913455b86f3aba921459982e.jpg[/img]
[h2]Get the Balloon Gun[/h2]
The Balloon gun is back and is as powerful as ever!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/ca5e107fc10561c2dc7493b1ffd0aa668588b1c8.jpg[/img]
Hold the shoot button after firing a balloon to greatly increase the size of the balloons attached to your target.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/c9058f1654d178571aed3b8f5642afc8f49e5493.jpg[/img]
Up, up and away! Heavier objects or vehicles will have much larger balloons for easier use!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/ea43fea32f12e7c17bb6009fb253f4f2cd349165.jpg[/img]
Watch frogs shoot  into the air!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/f7e8c8aa5e7e9553fdc8dca4041527a95ca54eae.gif[/img]
There they go!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/f776fa885091d96b01d0ac822de8bdc801909147.jpg[/img]
[h2]Get ready for Launch in Swindon![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/6d6aea29cf33c4237dc1a0bcce2602638493ea6b.jpg[/img]
Take flight in the Lunar Lander, thanks to a little help from the toilet!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/b19886ffcc2a674c4db7b59f3b40efed5faf196c.jpg[/img]
[h2]Hungry Shark Blimp[/h2]
Here's a giant shark blimp to drive around in! Inhale objects into its mouth as you fly!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/8d5c4d940f545e7f726320307d961d950d484014.jpg[/img]
See how it dwarfs the MEGALODON! Not so tough now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/00ac613e271b0cfe4248eddd02c777b9eaf01a5c.jpg[/img]
[h2]Penny Farthing[/h2]
A strangely vintage bicycle has been added as a vehicle. You need to flush a similar vehicle down the toilet to find it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/237c9dfb2cfe23700afbb8be49daeccf47838f4f.jpg[/img]
It has a really old time feel when you ride it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/481bad4b6aa8055eeee91aa2054935b267d860ce.jpg[/img]
[h2]Poop Guns[/h2]
Now the poop guns can only be found by flushing it's counterpart down the toilet!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/342418e3b4131df155e468a8073912f0367e05dd.jpg[/img]
[h2]A More Cinematic Handheld Camera[/h2]
The handheld camera now has less perspective in its lens when you use it to look around. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/1b17c3cd1f1634183a367a0879ab2706184dde7b.jpg[/img]
See the flies on the world map more easily.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/a159bb6da14647871496ea3c8eedf6006622b6a8.jpg[/img]
We ditched the wide-angle lens in the camcorder for now, in favour of a 35mm approach.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/041a44b4e0d03c6a2a3500120e78e382a6a09a91.jpg[/img]
Try it yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/4152badbff5be2ec5882bbb147c30e5760a98400.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/58b8ffac7c44862db9995a5eff4ca1d3fafd7dad.jpg[/img]
[h2]Improvements to the Balloons![/h2]
We've fixed the balloons so the physics are more reliable! They are improved all round with the balloon gun and balloon jetpack.



That's just about it, thanks for reading and let us know what you think about these new features!

notes.title: Amazing Frog? The Bank of Swindon (QMMT Part 5)
notes.notes:
[h3]QMMT Part 5 is here to bring business back to Swindon.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/2fc5dab3c6b31e69f38ef690edb767cf0829b3dc.gif[/img]

[h2]So What's new?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Deposit and withdraw your savings at the Bank!
[*] Reach saving milestones and get rewarded with loyalty gifts
[*] Upgrades to the weapons app
[*] SCP (Swindon Citizen Points) app is back!
[*] Emotes are back! Along with the infamous cough fart!
[*] Giant creatures are now "killable"
[*] Lorries/trucks are back along with the giant gas canister!
[*] New buildings/details added to Swindon (ready for future updates)
[*] More frogs!
[*] Bug Fixes
[/list]
[h2]The Bank is Open![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/f400975ccf76ba3106164db3624a041d0929e921.jpg[/img]
Get down to the Bank of Swindon to start your account! If you want to take money out of your account you can simply walk into the vault and find your physical stash! 

[h2]The Vault[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/8dca11785de24423dd345113c3fcc4938641ff23.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/9a43c17b745420b4ded9fb9422e09c2b48757126.jpg[/img]
From here you can pick up your cash and pocket it or throw it outside.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/3bdf637b4433d708b352561bf50cc9e92d3a32c4.jpg[/img]
Deposit your Frog Pounds at any cash machine you find around Swindon. Don't forget to hold the action button to deposit faster.

[h2]Golden gifts[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/89360f48a424423ae36292bcb3aba83492d2904c.jpg[/img]
Get rewarded by the Bank of Swindon Rewards program As you save more frog pounds in you vault you will receive higher tier BoS gifts. (We will be introducing new ways to make money in later updates).

[h2]Express yourself![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/53375f9cf5878b8140c4862267fded6a07e2aee6.jpg[/img]
Use the emote app to perform actions!

[h3]Wave to your friends![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/46bcb98461f49d50a3004a976c57f8d35da96e1c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Show the world how you feel![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/c1584eba9b8c34dad1237eb215b7578fb894a5c4.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/3a375cb2f9c8a8b7727dd0f5c39be31258e5e8b9.jpg[/img]
Use the inventory app to see every item you have collected so far! You can use the app to take items out of your inventory and back into the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/7c937e185ca5fa1b8e72415bb61e491f83d8c2e0.jpg[/img]
Put your collections in the environment! Just don't expect them to stay there after you reload the world!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/0082fd2768efd6ec96904a09435ce6312b338156.jpg[/img]
The military drone is improved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/c3ef10a6ac091bf92b7ec83b8c84302c4ab980f1.jpg[/img]
We are always trying to improves the way frogs interact with each other. you may see frogs engaging in fights across Swindon. Or you can start fights yourself...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/f38ee1e84415526254dfabcbac1379390da290cf.jpg[/img]

[h2]QMMT Content Plan[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/c3fd98e22860bf27acbf9f7050f9380714570363.png[/img]

Our plan to complete the Magical Mystery Toilet and then leave Early Access remains unchanged. It has been important for us to first ensure that the underlying systems are functioning properly, as this will create a strong foundation for future toilet-related activities (and more). While this process involves revisiting and recreating legacy content, our focus is very much on refining how everything works in the game’s current context.

In the past, when we were working on what we now call Legacy, we were always trying to move forward. Now, prioritizing key systems like adding a bank has allowed us to introduce the Frog Pound, Swindon’s economy, and an inventory system—features we originally wanted to include in Legacy. Whats even more exciting to us is that with newer these systems in place, future tasks will be able to offer a wider range of rewards and it massively helps us take QMMT far beyond what we could have achieved if we had been able to continue updating Legacy. 

So, I genuinely hope we can get out of Early Access in 2024 and I will do everything i can to make that happen, especially since Nov 22nd is a key date for Amazing Frog? - As Nov 22nd marks 10 years in Steam Early Access.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/8437bcc96b223e3fe4c85e67a58b4955422cb81b.jpg[/img]
We will add other modes to party mode as we progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/2437ba6ff5cfc2d09b50ffa983aa7392275cbf36.jpg[/img]
We have been having a lot of fun using Steam Remote Play for Amazing Frog? in Party Mode and Swindonshire - just bring up Steams Menu and ask a friend to join Remotely. We will start Supporting Remote play as we progress.

[h3]Next Steps and Leaving Early Access[/h3]

So That was a massive Long Blog post about QMMT Part 4, so if you are still  reading this firstly "Hello" secondly, I would like to end this post by sharing a little more information about what our plan is.
Its been a long road and its no secret that we have been prepping console versions of Amazing Frog? But  we will not be ready for console until we leave Early Access on Steam. Leaving Early access is not the end of Amazing Frog? its another beginning for the game.
This is how we will leave Early access and we are close now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/0bd33a335c14ea7d3e7c4170aa0b8df4ebafd736.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [h3]Cops and Robbers[/h3] An update that will not only bring cops and robbers and the prison back which would lead to bat frog, joke frog etc, but this will also bring cop frogs that will attempt to enforce Frog Law. This actually extends to all kind of behaviour that I will talk about later .
[*] [h3]UFO and tractor Beam[/h3] - This will be inevitable Alien Invasion. its mostly done but not quite ready for launch yet, but the UFO will have pretty cool abilities.
[*][h3]All the Outfits[/h3] - We know how important the OG Frog outfits are to you and we will not leave early access without them unlockable in the game! ( and the new ones)
[*] [h3]Party Mode[/h3] - We need to do a few more passes on Party Mode, but I do not think we need to fully complete all the modes etc before we leave Early Access.
[*] [h3]The Magical Mystery Toilet[/h3] - Where is it ? Its important to get all the stuff in the game before I finish and release the Magical Mystery toilet mechanics. I ghave my reasons,  because trust me things are going to get wierd... whats the point of a UFO if you cannot dump it in the toilet? what does that do??? etc 
[*] [h3]That Statue on the island....[/h3]  well more on that later.
[/list]

notes.title: Its a Frog Blog?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/b126f89cb6fd602904450d7ef5cf0efa52fd8273.jpg[/img]
Hello and welcome to a Frog Blog... its been a while since I wrote a Frog Blog for Amazing Frog? particularly for Quest for the Magical Mystery Toilet.
I wanted to let you know what we had been working on and that Amazing Frog? QMMT part 4 will be available very soon.

Its going to be a pretty big Update. Hal, Georgina and I played using Steam Remote Play for a few hours and I recorded it. Then we edited it down to some "Raw Gameplay videos" which I think give a rough idea of the scope of the coming update.

This first "RAW Gameplay" is from Swindonshire

[previewyoutube=I4PpCZYJuj0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]In Swindonshire[/h2]

So since the last update we have been flooding Swindonshire with a bunch of content and new areas. Also Hal has been making improvements throughout the world. What we are aiming for is a more complete and populated Swindonshire, so exploration is fun.

[h3]Trains - (In Next Update)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/2f5ed78bb098171d07e1c74a41e7f50d3333150c.jpg[/img]
It had seemed important to have trains in Swindonshire for some time now. Thanks to Hal's ingenuity he can now integrate train tracks to the terrains. (you may notice some improvements in the roads in general)

[h3]The Farm  - (In Next Update)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/7d3ba03762839f6248f8f736e9426a784522b82f.jpg[/img]
There be a farm out there somewhere and maybe some pigs live there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/12e1fb4218186aa3ee1cb2f6048e54be2086a37a.jpg[/img]
Tractors are a lot of fun actually.
Having a Farm is more than cosmetic. There are things we are working on for QMMT that need a farm... or a bank or whatever. When I am asked what the berrys or mushrooms do and whats the point of collecting them... well hopefully it will all begin to make sense.

[h3]The Army Base  - (In Next Update)[/h3]
We have been working on some Army stuff... I guess you can imagine how that will pan out... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/09f2220d68dc261180a6eb30c86bcf12c3c2d6d1.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/f5353eedea8a5940d1d363f9fcb38be0efbf7dd2.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/b341ff873fe536f488a8b4ed95da01b161c8efa2.jpg[/img]
I mean Tanks ... yeah they still need some tweaking and some wierd things can happen... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/90e7fe130a24fd6725712dd504836a1ac01459f6.jpg[/img]
Also, we are all agreed here that the Army Helicopter needs a machine gun...

[h3]Frog Life[/h3]
Frog Life Keeps progressing. With all these new archetypes of Frog Life(or non life) Zombies, Army, Farmer, skeleton etc...etc we have been trying to refine their characteristics, motivations and stimulae and I try and find as much time as i can to push our wierd frog AI a bit further each time. All so we can get more enjoyment out of the NPC Frogs. As part of this process we have been trying to make it easier to create and manage different archetypes. (I hope one day as a player you can make and share your types of Frog Life) So we'll see how this develops. 

[h2]The Party Mode Beta?  - (In Next Update)[/h2]

This other 'RAW Gameplay' video is us playing 'Free Play' mode in our new revision of the Party Mode Beta.

[previewyoutube=9_228khBeio;full][/previewyoutube]

In the new "Party Mode Beta", Initially we'll be making the "Free Play" mode available, but we have many more modes in development that you will be able to use through 'Remote play' or even play in the same space... you know like on a sofa. Also some Modes in Party Mode, including 'Free Play', will also be open as single player as well.
To give an idea, the mode names we are working with right now (and I hope they are self explanitory) are :
[list]
[*] Free Play (In Next Update)
[*] Crown Capture (SOON)
[*] Survival (SOON)
[*] Last Frog Standing (SOON)
[*] Deathmatch(+Team Deathmatch)(SOON)
[*] Balloon Burst(Working Title)
[*] Bomb Tag(Working Title)
[/list]

There are going to be more and I wouldn't limit us to those working titles. We are aiming to give as much variation as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/491d0f3957e349ed82e43e5cd27f9c08595fd6c4.png[/img]
There are a whole bunch of new party mode worlds coming too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/62785337db8b97c12246ca578f02ccede5a0ce52.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/6a3e9e73fa2b7ff948bcbdf6888db8a74ec8a75a.jpg[/img]
Party !
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/8e3fd7dd557267b8c614b83d73dfeaef5efa43a5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/706666a8382432fe41b32f60d72130f585ccce4d.png[/img]
The scope for Party Mode is huge. We can experiment and develop all kinds of modes without destabalizing Swindonshire and the moon etc. Some modes could be based entirely on vehicles or odd scenarios. We're excited.

Being Green can help - [h3]Spot the Frog[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/be55174e0395a8bed3f43d6815e2c64103f49f92.jpg[/img]

[h3]Development - So things have been getting tougher more recently. [/h3]

Its no secret that we bit of more than we can chew by adding in a lot of content, (especially Party Mode Beta)- but we have also been trying to leave Early Access. Its silly having Amazing Frog? and Amazing Frog?2 both in Early access.

[h3]Leaving Early Access for us means hitting Amazing Frog? with a stamp of approval saying "we think its ready". [/h3]

We need to get Amazing Frog? to a more well produced and refined state . This will not mean we are done working on Amazing Frog? we have a lot more to come after we leave Early Access. But at the point we leave Early Access we are also saying that Amazing Frog? is ready for the console versions which we have been very active in working on too.  Over the past year we have made signifiate progress on Switch which I think is the hardest one.
Giving Amazing Frog? this "stamp of approval" adds up to a lot of different things, ranging from User Interface, such as on screen help to encourage first time players to hit the stand button when they think the game is broken as they watch the frog flop around in the hideout. To managing how content is loaded and saved in a more professional manner or run time management code running on sperate threads so we don't get code churning and what of percieved as "lag" when you go between active zones. 
Its difficult having to focus on all this boring stuff , when all in all I just want to add time controls or a massive blob monster and online multiplayer. A daily dilemma... Then I remember - these things can continue to happen after we leave Early Access any way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/cc1c923be18929e1761f9c020d79ca0c2fc79dbe.jpg[/img]
So stand by - QMMT part 4 is almost ready and will contain a proper Beta of Party Mode, Army Frogs, Tanks, Jeeps, Zombie Apocalypse, aliens and whole bunch of stuff. 
Most importantly it will begin wave of rapidly successive updates for Amazing Frog? QMMT as we enter the summer and hopefully leave Early Access
...finally.

[previewyoutube=bZw6kB3OSC0;full][/previewyoutube]

This update also includes some major improvements to the "frog life" systems.
No I am not saying you will never see a "T poser" again, but I have spent a bunch of time stabilizing that aspect of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/a0e356f143547d3ce6f1f871a885024318f131c5.jpg[/img]

[h2]Some Game Dev stuff (If you like that kind of thing)[/h2]
Basically one of the big enhancements of QMMT since Legacy is our ability to have frogs everywhere. We have been working on this for a while with the goal of helping the gameplay scale across the whole world.  When I talk about the frogs customization system or placement  and organization of dynamic objects I have my system acronyms like W.R.A.P.S. and F.A.P.S.  I don't really have an acronym for this system other than AAARRGH maybe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/a82a73733eac56a1251810bc3e6499c2de5b29ca.jpg[/img]

I tentatively call it Scheduling and Priming. So Wildlife/population or as I call them in code 'Avatars' are "primed" everywhere thanks to Hals ingenious placement systems that he has been creating in Houdini on the landscape for trees, flowers grass  (not just for Avatars) Then with a kind of bespoke LOD thing we built I bring them in and out. This is why there will be sharks at every beach ( although this can be tricked by having two or more players on different beaches ) Unfortunately, one of the drawbacks of this system, aside from the mental torture it inflicted on my brain, was that if it doesn't clear up properly we get T posers which were frogs that were supposed to be deactivated but had refused to do so. Its an evolving system. You may notice it in Amazing Frog? 2 (V3) when that update drops soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/593a48925330cd578f182adb6fc3546af7615773.jpg[/img]

[h2]Things that are not ready[/h2]
So... Jet Pac can be unlocked by killing giant moon worm. Although currently, its very difficult. The giant moon worm can be ridden straight into the green lazer beam, but it would take some kind of a genius to work out how to do that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/c05af4230f95c5eb6379791bdde58341631ea423.jpg[/img]

Balloon pac and Fly pac officially are not unlockable yet.  Currently they are only accessible if they were unlocked during Legacy and then a version prior to Last year of Remastered was opened. (Sounds like a Monty Python Sketch) 
I am genuinely sorry for those that expect to have the back pacs because they had them in Legacy. There are so many right and wrong ways to simultaneously remaster and recreate a game I only know this way and I am 99% sure I am doing it the right way. 

Of course, I could just make the back pacs all available in the dispenser round the back of the hideout for every one, temporarily, but at this point it won't be long. Making them all available feels like a 'game breaking' thing to do. The Magic for the Toilet is coming, its mostly built. Unfortunately there is nothing I can 'bring' over from Legacy and to be honest I wouldn't want to. The magic for the toilet will give you access to all the toys you could drop in before, saddles for all creatures (although I think a saddle gun may be a good idea.), poop heads, mini pigs, pimped up vehicle and the shark blimp its all coming, but with more.

notes.title: QMMT part two BUG FIXES!
notes.notes:
[h2]Wardrobe[/h2]
This is typical really, but let let me tell you a story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/2e9ab89a9932b428e13680236c25a6e8d4e1033c.jpg[/img]

Did you know a major bug of the last update ( QMMT part 2 "Beaches Be Crazy" ) was the wardrobe exit not working and thats this bug was actually caused by fixing a bug you may not have even noticed. The bug I fixed the night before I released  QMMT part 2 was that if player one entered a spawnPoint toilet and then player two entered a spawnPoint toilet before player one has left then they fused into each other and it was game over...
It took a while to fix, you'd think it would be simple, these things never are and then I uploaded and I did not think to go and change my clothes in the wardrobe after fixing. So I missed it.
 
Its fixed now sorry,  Game development has its ups and downs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/b7c56488279131b58cd91faad22e2782edd46ea7.jpg[/img]

[h2]The balloon Jet pack, Fixed? [/h2]
This is tricky. I knew it wasnt quite right for some time, but for some reason I forgot that you used to be able to unlock the balloon pack via Legacy. I used to invisibly import your Legacy save file and convert it. In retrospect this was a silly thing to have done. Its difficult to keep track of progress when progress is coming from two different places and the reality is I really wanted the game to offer the unlock to the balloon jet pack and balloon gun differently than just throwing stuff in the toilet. To put it bluntly fixing an issue with the balloon jet pack wasnt a major priority for me since it wasnt officially 'unlockable' in QMMT yet. ironically, the fly pack (only unlockable from Legacy currently) works so much better in QMMT than it ever could have with Legacy Physics. Long story short - I fixed balloons but I still want to spend some more time with them over the coming weeks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/5c75f971e588dcc8017bca3c43b2222ef9926be5.jpg[/img]

This image by the wind farm is a classic representation of this issue of Legacy | QMMT confusion - balloon jet pack and shark hat unlocked in Legacy and a blood world Tshirt that is only available in the QMMT bloodworld, in the coffee shop (...To be completely honest, I don't know as I am writing this, if that T shirt award is currently working now the physics has been changed.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/ca9c287e0c9ea551cafbc5fdf6748c329e582588.jpg[/img]

Either way, QMMT does a few other types of things will balloons

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/85c601707497e28611eb9b09c6f78ce7bd8d66b1.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/6e80cd6bd8f8f222a17ea6039ed7cc447cfc9325.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/23cbf8ed80f86bbf79656b5a9d29b3fc224a1099.jpg[/img]


[h2]Grapple hooks missing?[/h2]
On or off right ? how can we make such and unforgivable mistake?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/b6caf0e62b98b762d3010d05e74d18a9106c7635.jpg[/img]

This was an issue with the load process similar to the trophys not working (which i have also attempted to fix). I cannot guarentee its completely fixed as nothing in life is certain, but it should be more stable. The saving in QMMT is very robust, but the reading and implemetation of the saved data still needs work - this is one of the main reasons for the delay of the "Magic" in the Magical mystery Toilet. There will be a lot of 'unlocks' from MMToilet activity and a need to represent those unlocks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/61b703c5ff3b7f825d288a42a994242d3dbe0ec0.jpg[/img]

Either way it was a lot fo fun double checking the balloon pack and grapple hook are still in good working order.
I am trying to get in the habbit of making a video each update since our intention is to make these upcoming regular updates more content based. Either way, it was fun to mess around with what had been fixed.

[previewyoutube=M0nXylH22dU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]T Posing Frogs[/h3]
Let me be clear -  I have [b]NOT [/b]fixed this yet... its is kind of freaky. However, it is a symptom of something good and something evolving. Before we made the changes to prepare for the Quest for the Magical Mystery Toilet,  having lots of Frogs and physics objects in the world was not possible in Amazing Frog? On the one hand, we could have drawn influence from great games like Human Fall Flat and made lots of smaller seperate environments with less physics objects in each, but we don't really roll like that. I think in our heads we are still trying to make our own Zelda/GTA/Tony Hawks Hybrid. (Skateboards coming soon)
So to explain the T posing  ( or frozen, non simulating , non animating) frogs are actually continuing to work, but in their lowest LOD level. A LOD level they should not be in when so close to the player. 

 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3051425671][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2120690798726457130/BDEEBBC4411779EF213993B4DCF5401AE64F49FE/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img][/url]
(Community Screen shot click to see)

Another symptom of this problem is shown by taking a sniper rifile and shooting something very far away, where currently the bullet might phase through the targeted object (I need to address this by activating objects via the scope). To enable more frogs and objects and vehicles etc, etc... Amazing Frog? now adds and removes objects from simulation, this was the only way we could bring content to the new world. (also it happens to be the bedrock of our evolving Online systems) So when I see them I know how far we have come ... but I guess without knowing what we have been building in the background it looks like we are just moving backwards... We are not.
So if you see T posing frogs and Objects not in simulation - walk away quite far then come back and they will be working like the Tyre was. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/899f77e4c913dfa8d1eebabe8d7b9583d00fadba.jpg[/img]

Also happy to hear of any non simulating objects - like the Fan by the Magical Mystery toilet... which I just noticed i did [b]not [/b]manage to fix in this update.

[h2]Legacy[/h2]
It took me a while but Legacy is now available on a beta Branch called Legacy Branch.
I know you guys never really read these posts ...( I mean. if I am being honest I wouldn't if I was playing a game I would just get on with it too...) but despite what people were saying in the forums last week, Hal and I never intended to take Legacy away from any one. I simply needed it on a new branch and these things take time. 
There are so many reasons to put it on a new branch. Its the kind of thing I could waffle about while making a you tube video comparing the two version, but here are two simple reasons 
[list]
[*] I intend to be updating QMMT like crazy until we have UFO, aliens, sandwiches, money, an inventory, a big f*ckin' blob monster and a whole host of othert crazy sh*t we have been developing and uploading an non-updatable version of Legacy with it each time is a pain.
[*] Lets say I do decide to suddenly open up my old single core PC and get an urge to update Legacy because I love punishing myself... It would not really be possible to do so if I had to upload it with QMMT - the main Version of Amazing Frog?
[/list]

[h2]A Note about Amazing Frog? QMMT , Amazing Frog? 2 and Amazing Frog? Legacy.[/h2]
We have been working on Amazing Frog? since 2012,  Launched on OUYA 2013, on Steam the end of 2014 (where most of dev has taken place) iOS 2019 and Android 2022 (Android could not support Legacy tech).  Origionally, what we now refer to as Legacy was built for single core machines, this is why Legacy does not run great on more modern multi-core machines (its embarrasing) , but it may appear to perform well on older single/dual core machines. Also it is near impossible to edit or develop Legacy on newer multicore machines. We didnt start QMMT (formally known as remastered) until just over two years ago and we did so alongside Amazing Frog?2.
QMMT is built with the evolving system that we have built from the ground up since 2020 to drive Amazing Frog? 2 . Visually it uses remastered assets from Legacy and new assets that we have been integrating and building. Since we started QMMT we even had to completely rebuild the landscape and change to a new rendering system. I believe whole heartedly that this process is worth it.  So that Amazing Frog? can Leave Early Access on Steam with a more well rounded and complete game - Amazing Frog? Quest for the Magical Mystery Toilet, can go to Console. All while we continue to evolve Amazing Frog? 2 to have more sandbox style, online gameplay much of which we can bring back to extensions to Amazing Frog? QMMT here on Steam in the future.
Feel free to dissagree with the way we develop, that bigger companies "do it better" -I know we do it different, but it makes sense to us. 
So... It may seem that  we have been away for a while, but we have been busy as f*ck. Hopefully over the next few weeks this will become apparant.
Also still no decision on the second part of the name for[b] Amazing Frog?2[/b] - but also a gentle reminder - Amazing Frog? 2 while it is currently included in a purchase of Amazing Frog? soon it will be sold seperately to new players, this will not change the for those that own it already.

notes.notes:

[previewyoutube=3eVuUo7E1WI;full][/previewyoutube] 
[h3]Mostly a whole new world ... mostly[/h3]
Since the coronation update in May, which saw a whole new swindonshire, we have been refining the world closer to its definitive form (minus a few more architechtural features still yet to come) and also fine turning and beautifying.

Collecting things is currently a W.I.P that we have been wanting to introduce for some time. Its comes at a cost in that the system is new, and baby systems can bring more bugs. Nonetheless, having more frogs has also given us the opportunity to enhance their motivations.

notes.title: Amazing Frog? Frog Blog 034 (UFO)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/44e5a4821f88e9003f9245db5f0daac0d1d9e993.jpg[/img]

It has been a while since we published a Frog Blog. Generally in favour of posting updates rather than Frog Blogs. We are reaching a pretty crucial milestone so now seems like a good time to start the Frog blogs again. If you were worried that we may have abandoned Amazing Frog? We have not. Amazing Frog? has always been in ongoing development. Thanks so much for your patience.
More recently, a lot has changed even since The Coronation Update and in all our time developing Amazing Frog? these past few months have been the most groundbreaking and definitive, not just for V2 but also V3. On that subject,  I would like to start by saying -

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/447647f3a9877f889a0c1245b8ca256160406547.png[/img]
[h3]We really need to change the terms “V2” and “V3”[/h3]

When I talk about the two versions of Amazing Frog? as “V2” and “V3” it feels awkward as these terms have become outdated. Technically “V1” is the OUYA version, but thought the process of bringing AF? to Steam it became V2  .“V2” is Legacy and since Remastered, but soon it will become the first “complete” version of Amazing Frog? Logically this would mean “V3” would become the second complete version of Amazing Frog? - “Amazing Frog? 2”
Both versions are set in the world of Swindon, Swindonshire which is mostly inhabited by the same wildlife ...mostly.  However, V2 is now is reaching its 1.0 status and V3 is only just getting started. On the surface, the idea of a small indie team working on two evolving versions of a game may seem ludicrous. Often, when I am discussing Amazing Frog? and talking about these 2 versions I feel like I am projecting and air of insanity.

Hal and I know there are deeper reasons as to why we are working simultaniously on two unfinished, evolving versions.

Its our “process”.  One to complete and one to evolve our game technology.

[h3]The renaming of V2 and V3.[/h3]

[b]Amazing Frog? : The Quest for the Magical Mystery Toilet [/b]
(QMMT for short)
This will be the new title for what is currently ‘Amazing Frog? V2 Remastered’  and this title will go across all platforms
 
As V3 now enters into a more experimental phase of its existence as it is no longer tethered to the V2 Remastering process it will likely bear a temporary Working Title of "Next Gen"

[b]Amazing Frog? Next Gen[/b] ( working title … formerly V3 )

We are completely undecided on the title at this stage, more development need to take place. To give you some idea here are a fraction of the titles we are toying with.

[list]
[*] Amazing Frog? Second Wind
[*] Amazing Frog? Follow Through
[*] Amazing Frog? Fallen Heroes
[*] Amazing Frog? World of Farts
[*] Amazing Frog? Kingdom of Farts 
[*] Amazing Frog? After Flush
[*] Amazing Frog? Second Flush
[*] Amazing Frog? Hell come To Frog Town
[*] Amazing Frog? Toadal Recall
[*] Amazing Frog? Aftermath
[*] Amazing Frog? Chronic Wind
[*] Amazing Frog? Froggy Mc Frogface
[*] Amazing Frog? Farter Starter
[*] Amazing Frog? Twisted Farter Starter
[*] Amazing Frog? The isles of Guff
[*] Amazing Frog? Spawn
[*] Amazing Frog? Quest for a Hero
[*] Amazing Frog? Invasion of the Penis Snatchers
[/list]

To be honest there are only a couple in there we would actually consider. I let you decide which ones are real contenders. If we do a poll in the future, we will announce on the Amazing Frog? Next Gen Community Page. I won’t talk about the development of Amazing Frog? Next Gen on this community page again as QMMT will take centre stage.  
Also just a. reminder that both versions will be sold separately as we approach the completion of the “Quest for The Magical Mystery Toilet”. 

[h3]So… Development.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/55ba99a962447e55964f3af86855729715dedfcd.jpg[/img]

[b]What has been taking so Long, Gaz?[/b]
Nothing has stopped us developing, we work on Amazing Frog? continuously and still love it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/f3bac028030e72a56e857fab62c8fcc1059bf264.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/1e3db9cc3372382ddc0e6045ead71eaf53e152fb.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/a9676774453a60cc0de1f799ecd18de0c1460b61.png[/img]

[h3]A Finished Version[/h3]
Our main goal has been to create a finished version of Amazing Frog? in which we can realize some of the core narrative elements we have been working towards. When I say narrative I don’t mean presenting a literal story mode, moreso presenting a structured and continuous sense of purpose thoughout Swindonshire, but without compromising the free roaming aspect of the Amazing Frog? gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/7c744371496475a11047999bb39aca052609964f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/84f50b1b2389fa713818510f2a1cf017c86f7ba5.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/e1d9a41894b0a5b17ea5324a3edbd4b45f8ff6c9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/3b27c179f7af3adaef5ca40916180f90bf7e5ae4.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/9bf1c2c381d2dec65098180d0f30df7c648a7df8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/21585d59be7a66f907fc869931ad7a6b5090feb5.png[/img]
[h3]Technical Challenges[/h3]
To give us the freedom to expand on the gameplay and make way for more content (especially physics content ) we needed to push through some major technical barriers. Barriers that had existed since Legacy. While we have made good progress breaking these barriers over the years, it is only recently we have managed to smash through them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/dc683fc5f1793197d57854334c1b016a18ff175b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/5f331c51bc21ae5cdc98593cf40ff9fb4665edca.jpg[/img]

For example, one of these barriers has been a limitation on the number of physics objects in Swindonshire. We came up with a solution allowing us to introduce more physics based content like frogs, creatures, vehicles, things to pick up sit on etc.. into what was a sporadically empty Swindonshire.  This solution also ensures Amazing Frog? can run on lower spec devices without loosing all the physics fun. In fact even with all this new content it will run even better on lower spec devices than the last update across all platforms. These improvements will be for all existing platform versions of QMMT, the upcoming console releases and they will also benefit Next Gen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/59911cca73bca5cc21be5524441bdd66d7db392d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/f14fa41d4eccaa966477b501d29d95005cbd2f7a.jpg[/img]

[h3]Beware The Chaos[/h3]
Rewards do not come without cost. The development time to implement these changes puts a lot of pressure on us while we are trying to also move content forward.  In the short terms I expect to suffer from some serious “bug anxiety” …Whilst these series of optimisations do yield huge physics performance increases, these new optimizations may lead to some unexpected wierdness. (Yay new bugs and edge cases ). With this in mind we are taking an “embrace the chaos” approach to the devolopment and we bring QMMT to its final form.  So despite the chaos, Its exciting that these enhancements have given us more creative and development freedom to populate Swindonshire with a more reckless abandon and allow us to evolve many of the features as we had originally intended. 

Frogs as Far as the eye can see.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/23cc0a285e938dfc76592c18564fa1bf3ad20bf8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/733d594d2a366b682f6681b1b3bb9fd08e9c2864.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/08936e9b7a4424929b759817151f9584a85fce4b.png[/img]

Updates Are coming...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/d222948073d45a4c21fa27055efc3424b24773cb.jpg[/img]

And things are going to get weird.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/a2a9fc1b04bdfe1216ddcbc77870bebfb8fea932.jpg[/img]

Also as we ramp up to 1.0 and leave Easy Access there will be a series of Updates and eventually including the "The Hero's Journey" to unlock the power of Amazing Frog?  in The Quest For the Magical Mystery Toilet

notes.title: Kickin' Holiday Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=W1U_yXDPaNA;full][/previewyoutube]
Happy Holidays, as we take our first step into melee combat in Amazing Frog? that you can now play around with in this festive Kickin' Update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/a384f6cf0ee421ebd6a67ac42c550c8b3b76ebf4.jpg[/img]

As you may know, Remastered is the process where we have been rebuilding the entirety of Amazing Frog? in a more updatable format to allow us to continue development and continue adding more content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/c9caf041ea72b476565582c6c285c7b94481c683.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/72471eb4460ebeea374a82a8a92c18f1dda6fc6e.jpg[/img]

Some things may feel different, like the way we count snowmen and SCP. Saving and notifications have to be upgraded from Legacy. Ultimately, we cannot carry all your legacy data to Remastered. We try where possible, but it can be restrictive adhering to saved data that derived from a different process. For example the fly pac, jet pac and balloon pack from legacy are still (temporarily) available from your legacy save file, but eventually they will need to be unlockable via a Remastered process since that aspect of the game will be completely rebuilt anyway.  
( I am very excited about the new toilet ... aka object transformation system with an even stronger  flush... er...  which will be coming in a future update )

Fish... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/16c64c6e998812e27fbeeaa72377190a636b5962.jpg[/img]

Yes, we have added fish, not to the sea, to the vending machine... thinking about it we should probably put them in the sea... I better double check its on our list.
So... we have extended the number of objects that you can hit things with. In our minds we have made melee weapons work much better, give them a go, but please wait till New year to inform us if you don't like it, feeling sensitive... might be able to turn off the blood... 

I should point out  we consider this to be Melee Part 1. The tip of the Amazing Frog? combat system iceberg. 

Hal and I have been chatting about Combat for years, looking at other games... fighting in the office etc etc  But Combat is  a gateway to deeper frog mechanics  and smarter npcs. Under the hood there were a lot of changes to make this happen and so while it may not look like there is much "content" - this is huge for us.
- Try kicking the wheels one by one on a vrog, for some lowrider action.

With character systems  in mind, I want to shine a spot light on the zombies... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/edf88db73799821c5071e0eb8626f40e08a619e1.gif[/img]

We have upgraded their movement and attack systems.. Again its not something you may notice unless looking for it. but in doing so we also looked at how all NPC frogs will respond to being attacked, by a player or each other.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/465cbfac78382172b9976cd6cda8393e706b984c.jpg[/img]

So watch out, they hit back!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/758f49fab8450bd75a9b94fe6620c7faa2918350.jpg[/img]

And they can hold a grudge so watch where you are swinging your foot around.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/1a1e8a7f90817a09852f319ebe0022bdef58b872.jpg[/img]

[h1]Now Kneel before the new Diorama on the title screen ![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/589111b848639e1fff2a497d9dd0165c543d1835.jpg[/img]

Also please throw any suggestions of what we could have in that diorama to help new players or returning old players see what's possible in the world of Amazing Frog? (V2 Remastered) 

Kick Boxing also included...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/6e6bec1744b5810e97ea8b11279627f83975ca02.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/a2cb1b84250035baecbcd8c7e1b6d8ea7e408754.jpg[/img]

Fixed the settings page and resolution issue, tweaked camera in various location and other fixes.[/h3]

Just in time for Halloween, Blood world has returned to Amazing Frog? 'Remastered'. So you can get your smashin' pumpkins on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/7f6821e6608bce0066bfeef52c66ab692843c372.gif[/img]

Watch out for those flamethrowers! Playing with fire can be very explosive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/f32222cbbd0040c1d208ad1970a23bcb7682eb31.jpg[/img]

We are glad to be getting more of the core legacy features available in 'Remastered'.

[h2]New Collection System[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/30f16e969ed715789b2a54a3a20049c72d721506.gif[/img]

Swindon Citizen Points ( S.C.P. ) and other collectables are now functioning in a newly remastered system. ( Basically saving and collecting things )

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/a7d65a158e93083312777cc9d1064903cd127c24.jpg[/img]

This brings back the cats, trophies, post (mail) boxes, Vending Machines that dispense Ammo ( goodbye infinite ammo ) and whole load of collectable rubbish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/388c028cb4dc32cee3bf08915683c4d57d6aa3c8.jpg[/img]

The systems behind saving data like S.C.P. needed rebuilding for Remastered (...and my sanity )  As part of this process we reintroduced many achievements along with some new ones. We quite like the t-shirts in remastered and there are quite a few of these added, with more to come. The key to the city has also been remastered. Frog Milk Coffee Co. is still in development. All in all pretty happy with how the new system works and it should be straight forward adding more 'saveables' as we continue the remastering process of V2.
Note: as far as S.C.P. goes... sorry I could not bring the S.C.P. from your legacy save file like did for the costumes and accessories, but at least now we can add more S.C.P. goals.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/96ffb55d81caa5e603c7883f2bc2f11d14f0dbfc.png[/img]

[h2]SPAWN POINT APP[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/d0643d24da6031335bd1e65d9c35d6e5315ac87b.jpg[/img]

Check out the Spawn Point App, It allows you to fast travel to lots of locations including separate worlds  that you have visited. Either enter a Spawn point Toilet to unlock a Spawn Point entry or visit a new world 
For example after you visit blood world you can then access blood world from the spawn point app. Its also handy in the sewer for completing the microscope tasks ;)

[h2]Revisited the the Sewer and Lab[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/ec03ae920b53e692cf4a6673dbd0f8cd9c6c106b.jpg[/img]

We made another pass on the Sewer and The Lab. If you did complete the microscopes on the last update, well done... we certainly couldn't!

it should be fixed and tweaked now so you can grab the launch codes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/7ff334bfcdb5005ce7c65c0f704fd8a7d9026c02.gif[/img]

Also we put a ladder in the sewer to help with key card retrieval. So getting those launch codes and then fuelling the Space rocket should now be achievable.. You should also be able to visit the Moon. But its in development! and while you can't go outside yet, you can still have fun with the new lasers ! 

[h2]PEW PEW PEW[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/ddbec9744d568fcb67207349d4a6dbe8b18d684b.gif[/img]

[h2]Party Mode[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/d6335200ce2a84081db8802c3b74cdb1eec7ffbf.gif[/img]

I never formally introduced Party Mode, this is because in the last update in June I didn't find the time to write words to go with the update.
Party Mode is currently running as a split screen death match. We had been wanting to add this mode for some time to V2. It will evolve as we develop the rest of remastered. For now I will just remark that it is there, and that when we add some larger features and play modes I will make more of a big deal about it :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/b117376fdafbfbcc4e9531eedd076c1ef6e98397.png[/img]

[h2]Fix it! Fix it! Fix it![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/80c888a01c7970cb80ba0245374705ea3f8efc52.gif[/img]

Should be a lot of fixes..
Honestly we have lost track, we don't tend to list each fix we make we just move on to the next one and keep going often finding ourselves back at the problem we fixed a month ago. 

progress.

Also, Remastered has a lot of new features that legacy didn't. Like choosing your frog. While playing in single or 4 player at any point you can choose your frog and start playing as one of the other avatars. There are also many types of objects that just don't exist in legacy like BMXs, mopeds, biplanes (with guns) or temporary balloon cannisters and flaming hot grills on the bbq. 

NOTE: (if you don't know the difference between 'Legacy' and 'Remastered' - in short Legacy was build over several years with older architecture and to continue developing Legacy we have to rebuild from the ground up.  This rebuilt version is called  'Remastered' and is being actively developed to supersede Legacy.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/7cd970c49d520109bb0b445824e50310bb5cf7ba.jpg[/img]

There are many improvements/fixes, some of these revolve around the NPCS , population density should work now and the frogs will no longer get caught in the gym. Modifications to cameras (eg on vehicles) while we still want to expand on the melee system we have also fixed some of the issues to do with using them. I know there are many more fixes, I just don't know what they all are, some of them you may not have even known were issues.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Worth noting that since we have been building remastered for other platforms too
[h3](Android Releases Nov 1st 2022)[/h3] 
There have been general optimizations throughout all systems. wink.
Also we have been testing on Steam Deck and we found it runs well in proton if you force compatibility. Steam have listed us as 'Playable' so that's progress, but we will endeavour to make it 'Verified' soon. (Because Steam Decks Rock)

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h2]...In Other news and following up[/h2]
I realised while writing this post that I didn't post any words in June when we last updated Remastered. I am very sorry about this. In June we added the sewers, introduced the spawn app gave first access to party mode [beta] 
At the time made this newer trailer,  the current official trailer for 'Remastered' which summarizes the previous update pretty well.

[previewyoutube=22dbqpq7lz4;full][/previewyoutube]

However, now I realise I will need to make a new trailer as this update has so many new features and fixes, but I will wait till the next major update.

[h2]Version Information [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7225053/9d9bcf3bc735f8532d524e82d27d3f2b276a04db.png[/img]

[h3]So Where is Amazing Frog? V3 ...?[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1559680

So, you will have noticed that Amazing Frog? V3 has Moved to a new App. Please give us some time to get this settled. For now all purchases of Amazing Frog? also reward Amazing Frog? V3 and visa versa.

This is because we didn't want to force anyone who had been playing over the years into buying Amazing Frog? again.
Initially V3 was created to replace V2... in the natural order of updates. The two versions are now too different. Uploading them separately makes life soooo much easier. Thank you Steam!

Regrettably, it does leave the situation quite complicated, but we are working on resolving this and making it clearer.

 I really need to post a blog on the new app's page. We are actively working on V3 and really excited about where its leading and our plans. We know it needs optimization, but please stick with us we will get there.

So stand by for news about V3 very soon...
